verdict.rationale: PostHog documents personal API keys that can be issued multiple times, each with its own scopes and individual revocation, and recommends least-privilege scope selection. The CLI docs give agent-specific guidance: use an MCP Server preset key for broad agent work, or grant only the scopes a command needs. A live probe confirms the MCP server is OAuth-gated with about 150 granular per-resource read/write scopes, and admins can audit keys by scope, project access and last-used time. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that scoped agent keys enforce least privilege in practice.
